_metadata.title: ComplianceLint Interim Standard for EU AI Act Article 51: Classification of GPAI Models with Systemic Risk
_metadata.disclaimer: This is an interim checklist developed by ComplianceLint. It is not a harmonised standard and does not itself give a presumption of conformity. No harmonised standard is requested for Article 51; Article 51 is in Chapter V, Section 1, outside the Chapter V Sections 2 and 3 standardisation route in Article 40. Article 51(3) empowers the Commission to adopt delegated acts to amend the thresholds and supplement benchmarks and indicators.
_metadata.awaiting_standard: No harmonised standard is requested for Article 51; Article 51 is in Chapter V, Section 1, outside the Chapter V Sections 2 and 3 standardisation route in Article 40. Article 51(3) empowers the Commission to adopt delegated acts to amend the thresholds and supplement benchmarks and indicators.

requirements.title: Cumulative FLOPs Threshold Assessment
requirements.requirement: The provider MUST assess whether the cumulative amount of computation used for training the GPAI model exceeds 10^25 FLOPs.
requirements.rationale: Art. 51(2) sets 10^25 FLOPs as the presumptive threshold for systemic risk classification.
acceptable_implementations: Documented computation log tracking total training FLOPs
Training infrastructure records with FLOPs estimation methodology
Third-party audit of training compute expenditure

requirements.title: High-Impact Capabilities Evaluation
requirements.requirement: The provider SHOULD assess whether its GPAI model has high-impact capabilities under Article 51(1)(a), using appropriate technical tools, methodologies, indicators and benchmarks; the Annex XIII criteria instead inform a Commission designation under Article 51(1)(b).
requirements.rationale: Art. 51(1)(a) classifies a model that 'has high impact capabilities evaluated on the basis of appropriate technical tools and methodologies, including indicators and benchmarks'; under Art. 51(1)(b) the Commission may designate a model having regard to the criteria set out in Annex XIII. This is a recommended internal classification practice, not an express provider duty under Article 51.
acceptable_implementations: Structured capability evaluation against Annex XIII criteria
Benchmark suite covering high-impact capability domains
Red-team evaluation report assessing systemic risk potential

requirements.title: Classification Record Maintenance
requirements.requirement: The provider SHOULD maintain an internal record of its assessment of whether its GPAI model meets the systemic-risk classification conditions and the supporting evidence.
requirements.rationale: Art. 51 sets the classification conditions; it does not itself require a record. A record of the assessment supports the notification under Art. 52(1), which must include the information necessary to demonstrate that the condition has been met.
acceptable_implementations: Classification decision document with FLOPs calculation and capability assessment
Internal classification register with periodic review schedule
Auditable classification trail with version history

scoring.partial: R01 met, R02 or R03 incomplete
